verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a code-first SDK. Its core capabilities (act, extract, observe, the agent, caching, browser launch/attach, contexts and clipboard) are documented as programmatic APIs across TypeScript, Python and Go, and are also exposed to agents through MCP tools. That means essentially all of the product's function is reachable without a UI. The only UI in the evidence is the Browserbase session dashboard, which belongs to the host platform, and the evidence does not show whether its replay and recording features have API equivalents. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, an API path for the dashboard's observability and replay features, and a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404).
